{{Top|leg}}
An '''epidermal flush''' was a medial procedure carried out after a significant skin graft. It ensured that the new skin would not be rejected by the host. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] of [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] received an epidermal flush as the final stage of [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|reconstructive surgery]] after sustaining significant injuries during a prison break.
